items.item_text: This position is subject to a background check. Any convictions will be evaluated to determine if they directly relate to the responsibilities and requirements of the position. Having a conviction history will not automatically disqualify an applicant from being considered for employment.
Lawrence Berkeley National Lab, 1 Cyclotron Road, Berkeley, CA. A REAL ID or other acceptable form of identification is required to access Berkeley Lab sites (for more information ).

items.item_text: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.
Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Over 10 years of experience in the construction, operation and maintenance of mechanical systems or 8 years of experience with a Master’s degree.
Experience managing external contractors or consultants, including scope development, performance oversight, and project management.
Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for assigned functions and act as primary engineer owning assigned mechanical, plumbing, and specialty plumbing systems.
Lead problem-solving efforts and meetings to set priorities and direction, providing expert support and resolving issues promptly.
Conduct equipment failure investigations, operational and trend reviews, and functional testing to evaluate system performance and address findings with stakeholders.
Evaluate systems' spare capacity and ability to support scientific equipment installations.
Develop conceptual designs and scopes of work to address deficiencies and improvements, coordinating with other disciplines to deliver complete scopes.
Specify equipment replacements for improved performance and cost-effectiveness.
Improve system documentation, diagrams, and procedures to reflect current conditions.
Contribute to infrastructure planning and modernization by providing recommendations that inform leadership's capital investment decisions.
Utilize the central maintenance management system (CMMS) to complete work orders and advise on asset history, repairs, and trends.
Work closely with, and at times manage, external consultants or contractors to execute assessments, or equipment replacements.
Maintain assigned master specifications, design guidelines, and standard details.
Registered professional engineer in the State of California, preferred.
Well versed in the technical aspects of commissioning and startup of mechanical systems.
Advanced trend review skills to assess equipment performance and issues.
Knowledge of HVAC water treatment practices for closed and open-loop hydronic systems, along with water purification, specialty gas, and compressed air (CA) system operation.
Knowledge of ASHRAE Guideline 36.
Strong knowledge of reliability principles, including root cause analysis, reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), and preventive maintenance planning.
Knowledge of IBM Maximo for asset and maintenance management.
Knowledge of applicable DOE Orders, Federal Standards, and related safety/compliance regulations.
